ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift and remove legacy parser shim
ordered_steps.summary: Audit and fix schema drift in the translator before any downstream work. The legacy parser shim currently masks schema drift in local smoke runs, which would cause the dashboard to render incorrect data.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema audit complete, drift fixed, legacy shim removed, translator emits stable step-id schema

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures for plan contract
ordered_steps.summary: Add fixtures so plan_contract.py catches ordering regressions when new step ids are introduced. This test currently fails without fixture updates.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: tests/plan_contract.py passing with new step id schema

ordered_steps.title: Enable translated release-plan dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the user-visible dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema is stable and fixtures are in place. Canary-only coverage exists.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary enabled behind kill switch, canary coverage passing

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Stabilize runbook after rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation of the summary path.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook and launch checklist reflecting proven rollout/rollback procedures

dependency_notes.reason: Dashboard summary consumes step-id schema from translator; schema must be stable before dashboard can render correct data
Dashboard must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect new schema; plan_contract tests must pass
Runbook only stabilizes after rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation

primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect or malformed step ordering to users if schema drift is not fixed before enabling the summary path
mitigations: Complete schema audit and fix drift (RN-101) before any dashboard work
Add dependency-graph fixtures (RN-102) so plan_contract catches ordering regressions
Enable dashboard behind kill switch (RN-103) for controlled canary rollout

assumption_ledger.note: Exact scope of schema drift is unknown until RN-101 audit completes
Existing canary coverage for dashboard summary is sufficient for initial rollout
Kill switch infrastructure for RN-103 dashboard feature exists and is functional
